title: Solid Edge workflows and connector status
description: Explore Solid Edge workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Siemens

Solid Edge

Solid Edge combines parametric and synchronous mechanical design with assemblies and manufacturing documentation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Revise a synchronous part

Use current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Solid Edge preview, revise a synchronous part; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Resolve an assembly fit

Start from the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Solid Edge preview, resolve an assembly fit; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Release a manufacturing drawing

Begin with the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Solid Edge preview, release a manufacturing drawing; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
